text:
alex: Heads-up: found a hole in backfill logic — KV cache rehydrate signals aren't tagging priority lane requests. Backfills are getting merged into regular reads and bumping p95 on /generate.
maria: saw spikes last night, assumed quota surge. Do we have a metric for 'rehydrate-request' traffic? :thinking:
parth: yes, there's metric telemetry.kv_rehydrate.request_count but it doesn't include priority flag. current schema: {shard, model, size_bytes}. we can add 'prio': boolean but that requires upstream producer change.
jen: changing producers is ok but rollout risk. Proposal: add a temporary routing tag at coordinator when scheduling backfills so routing policy treats it as background lane (lower weight) — no producer change.
alex: that would work. coordinator emits header `x-backfill-priority: background` on Kinesis message; downstream consumers check header and mark trace. How do we ensure it doesn't surface to hosted API? it's internal only.
parth: headers in kinesis can be kept in the envelope. We'll need small shim in ingest lambda to set `priority=background` on event. I'll draft patch.
maria: question: will background lane still coldstart models? we want to avoid triggering new pods during peak.
alex: policy: if priority=background -> route to dedicated 'backfill' pool with quota cap 10% of total capacity and no autoscale above cap. Fallback: if pool exhausted, queue; do not spill to public pool.
jen: sounds safe. Add observable: metric `backfill.pool_utilization` and alert when queue_time > 60s. Also add log line `backfill_route=background` at INFO level for tracing.
backfill-bot: deploy status: coordinator change merged to canary on staging -> 2024-11-01T03:12:00Z
parth: patch: ingest-lambda adds header, scheduler routes to backfill-pool. I'll open PR and add tests for not setting header for live-api requests.
alex: also need a console UX: toggle to throttle backfills per env and link to recent backfill runs. @maria can you track with frontend team?
maria: yes, will create a small panel on Telemetry -> Jobs. Will include counts, avg queue_time, last_run. ETA EOW.
jen: ok, let's aim to ship coordinator + ingest + routing + metrics this sprint. If anyone blocks on infra perms ping me.
